summary: Microbot Medical filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a routine press release, not a special situation. The company announced that the Canadian Intellectual Property Office granted a patent covering an adaptor for coupling a proximal portion of an elongate surgical tool (guidewire, microcatheter) to a motorized robotic surgical device used in its LIBERTY Endovascular Robotic System. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction dates are stated. The release notes the company now holds 45 issued patents and 48 applications worldwide, including 21 North American issued patents. The filing is furnished, not filed, for Section 18 purposes. No deal or risk-arb angle exists; the event is ordinary IP portfolio development.
